literal.prompt: Как называется повторяющаяся сократительная единица скелетного мышечного волокна?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The source calls the sarcomere the functional unit of a skeletal muscle fiber (L48, L52, L56, L59) and later calls sarcomeres its contractile units (L85). It places myofibrils inside the fiber and bundles sarcomeres within them (L49, L56); myofilaments are actin or myosin components (L48, L52-L58); a fascicle groups muscle fibers (L39). These are distinct levels of skeletal-muscle organization, and only sarcomere is the repeated contractile unit.
literalGroups.locator: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e 10.2 L48, L52, L56, L59, L85; alternatives: L39, L49, L52-L58.

literalGroups.literal: Саркомер — участок миофибриллы между соседними Z-дисками. При сокращении миозиновые нити тянут актиновые к центру саркомера, укорачивая мышечное волокно.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L56-L59 identify the sarcomere as the segment of a myofibril between adjacent Z-discs. L71 states that myosin pulls actin filaments toward the sarcomere center, shortening the muscle fiber; the explanation paraphrases these two claims.
literalGroups.locator: OpenStax 10.2 L56-L59 (sarcomere between Z-discs within myofibril); L71 (myosin pulls actin toward sarcomere center and shortens fiber).

literalGroups.literal: Миофибрилла — длинная сократительная структура внутри мышечного волокна.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L49 describes a muscle fiber as composed of many fibrils, and L56 says a myofibril runs the length of the fiber and contains many sarcomeres. This grounds the note's location and extended contractile structure.

literalGroups.literal: Миофиламент — нить актина или миозина внутри саркомера.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L48 names actin as a thin myofilament and myosin as a thick myofilament; L52-L58 describe their arrangement in each sarcomere. The note states this composition.

literalGroups.literal: Мышечный пучок объединяет группу мышечных волокон.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L39 defines each fascicle as an individual bundle of muscle fibers. 'Мышечный пучок' is the Russian label used for that bundle.

literalGroups.literal: Саркомер ограничен соседними Z-дисками; к ним прикрепляются тонкие актиновые филаменты.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L57 says each sarcomere is bordered by Z-discs and that actin myofilaments are anchored there; L59 restates the sarcomere as the region between successive Z-lines. The note adds this anatomical boundary and anchoring fact beyond prompt and key.
